name: CDNA4 Matrix Core MFMA instruction precision support (MXFP8, MXFP6, MXFP4)
workarounds: TF32 is NOT natively supported on CDNA4 - AMD's product page footnote says 'TF32 support through software emulation'
MXFP8, MXFP6, and MXFP4 are natively supported on CDNA4 via OCP MX (micro-scaling) formats
MXFP6 and MXFP4 run at 2x the FP8 rate (9.2 PFLOPS on MI350X, 10.1 PFLOPS on MI355X)
MXFP8 runs at the same rate as OCP-FP8 (4.6 PFLOPS on MI350X, 5.0 PFLOPS on MI355X)
notes: CDNA4 (gfx950) Matrix Cores add native hardware support for OCP MX (micro-scaling) formats: MXFP8, MXFP6, and MXFP4. Execution resources for 16-bit and smaller data types are 2x the prior generation. The key addition is MXFP6/MXFP4 at 9.2 PFLOPS (MI350X) / 10.1 PFLOPS (MI355X) - 2x the OCP-FP8 rate. This means 4-bit inference is natively accelerated on CDNA4, not emulated. MXFP8 uses block-scaled representation (per-block scaling factors) which provides better accuracy than per-tensor FP8 for the same bit width. CDNA4 does NOT have a native TF32 matrix path - AMD's footnote says 'TF32 support through software emulation'. The vector FP16 path (157.3 TFLOPS on MI355X) is 16x slower than the matrix FP16 path (2500 TFLOPS), a new asymmetry on CDNA4.
